Roadmap.title: Freedom is often lost quietly.
Roadmap.description: Most people don’t lose freedom all at once. It disappears in small recurring expenses.

lifestyle.title: Lifestyle
lifestyle.description: Most financial pressure starts long before investing. It begins with what quietly becomes normal.

habits.title: Habits
habits.description: The things we repeat every day slowly shape how much room we have in our lives.

capital.title: Capital
capital.description: Money changes meaning when it stops being consumed automatically.

time.title: Time
time.description: Freedom rarely arrives suddenly. Most of it is built slowly over years.
